content:
The HWPX generation failed because the required 'High (즉시조치)' severity string was missing from the XML sections of the output document.
The test_overview_values_and_actions_are_present failed with an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, the verifier expected the string 'High (즉시조치)' to be present in the combined XML content of section0.xml and section1.xml, but it was not found. While the summary and immediate_actions JSON files were likely generated, the HWPX XML structure failed to correctly map and embed the '위험등급' (Risk Level) value.
